notes: This paper (Pohl 2019) tested 12 different Göemar BM seaweed extract products (BM-86 through BM-97) on eggplant yield across 6 cultivars (Cristal F1, Epic F1, Flavine F1, Gascona F1, Onyx F1, WA 6020 F1) and 2 years (2013, 2014). The GT contains 12 pairs (17-28), one per product, presumably aggregated across cultivars and years. Our extractor only captured BM-86 data (22 per-cultivar per-year obs), missing the other 11 products (BM-87 to BM-97). Severe coverage failure: 11/12 GT pairs have no JSON counterpart. For the one matchable pair (GT 17 = BM-86), there is a direction conflict: GT shows -8.93% effect while all JSON BM-86 marketable yield obs show positive effects (+6 to +22%). This discrepancy may reflect: (1) the GT aggregating across cultivars/years differently than our extraction; (2) the GT possibly using a different yield metric (total rather than marketable); or (3) the GT incorporating data from all 6 cultivars and 2 years in a pooled analysis where some cultivars showed negative responses. The match is flagged as low confidence.
